processCards.name: Content & link planning
processCards.description: Each month your strategist reviews performance and the competition, then sets the content and links for the month ahead. Planning from live data rather than a fixed list keeps every piece pointed at the pages and searches that will move the needle.

processCards.name: Strategist task planning
processCards.description: The competitive gap sets the next best actions: onpage, technical, local or off-page tasks. Working the gap in order sends effort where the business is furthest behind, not where the work is easiest.

processCards.name: Specialist work execution
processCards.description: Our specialists work through the planned tasks. Volume varies with complexity, implementation time and approvals. This is where the plan becomes real changes on the site and in the market.

processCards.name: Performance review
processCards.description: A weekly look at what is happening right now: rankings, traffic and leads, to catch any negative impact early and carry the wins to other areas of the campaign. Rankings move constantly, so a weekly review means a problem costs days, not a quarter.

processCards.name: Big picture review
processCards.description: A strategist steps back from the day-to-day numbers and asks: what else, and what different? Where the performance review keeps the campaign on track, this one changes the track, looking for ways to stand apart rather than only close the gap.

processCards.name: Campaign monitoring
processCards.description: Technology and AI watch the site and its market every day for issues and opportunities, raising alerts that become tasks or conversations. Continuous monitoring means a broken page, a lost ranking or a competitor move is spotted the day it happens.

defaultPackage.name: Tiny
defaultPackage.description: The base managed campaign for a single-location service business in a low-competition market.

defaultPackage.name: Typical
defaultPackage.description: The most-quoted campaign for local service businesses: content, links, Business Profile activity and citations, worked weekly.

defaultPackage.name: Turbo
defaultPackage.description: For competitive and multi-location markets: the most content, links and Business Profile activity we run on one campaign, with a monthly big picture review.
